history.summary: UNVERIFIED IDENTITY: no independent history, founding date, or confirmed description could be found for a "Lakshmi Narayan Temple" in Dimapur. The only web footprint for a Lakshmi shrine in Dimapur is a Justdial listing "Laxmi Temple" at B Village, Block 2, Purana Bazar, Dimapur 797116 (hours Mon-Sun 06:00 AM - 01:00 PM; the same listing also says "Opens at 03:00 PM" - CONFLICT). This file provisionally maps the CSV row to that shrine, but the name match is uncertain. Deities and festivals are inferred from the temple name only, not from a source. No reliable image of the actual shrine was found.

name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple
town_description: Purana Bazar is an old locality on the edge of Dimapur, Nagaland's largest city and its commercial hub. Dimapur sits at the foothills of the Naga Hills in Dimapur district and is the main gateway into the state, home to its only civil airport and a key railway station. The Purana Bazar area is one of the town's traditional bazaar settlements.

travel.road: Purana Bazar is on Dimapur's road network, reachable by auto-rickshaw from the city centre (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (pleasant weather); Diwali for Lakshmi worship (verify)
